collection.title: XPENG G6 2025 to 2026 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a XPENG G6 2025 Onwards model which requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 16" for the passengers side. This model uses the Notched Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
